title: PageEnumPresentationDescriptor
description: Page-level overrides for how the values of one enum property are displayed. The shared enum descriptor keeps the default presentation; this object changes it for a single page.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use page enum presentations when one page needs different labels, badges, colors, or icons for an enum property without changing the enum used by other pages. `propertyName` must be an enum property of the page entity and must be unique within `enumPresentations`. Each `values[]` item targets one integer enum `value`; only the fields present are overridden. A field set to `null` clears the value inherited from the enum or a lower model layer.

propertyName.description: Enum property on the page entity whose value presentation is overridden.

values.description: Per-value overrides. Each integer value may appear once.

presentation.description: Page-specific presentation: text, badge, or iconOnly.
